XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure to engage gears with EPC warning light on vehicles with automatic transmission
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | DSG | DQ200 | EPC | P0562 | P1604 | P17BF | P189C | DRIVE | FUSE | GEAR | ENGAGEMENT | SYMBOL | FLASHING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles fitted with a 7-speed DSG automatic gearbox (DQ200)

  • System: Gearbox

  • Component: Transmission control unit

  • Fault: The vehicle is unable to engage any gear. The EPC warning light remains on in the instrument cluster and the symbols on the gear lever flash continuously.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0562 (16946/001378) – Low nominal voltage
    • P1604 (005636) – Internal electronic control unit
    • P17BF (06079) – Pump protection limit reached
    • P189C (06300) – Function limited due to insufficient pressure build-up
  • Cause: Internal fault in the gearbox electronic control unit

• Action: Check and, if necessary, replace the electronic gearbox control unit

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Faults in the electronic gearbox control unit are quite common in the DSG DQ200
